svg.title: The farming axis across an irrigated western valley
svg.desc: A block diagram of a flat irrigated valley below dry, oak-dotted foothills, with a canal along the foot of the hills, a sandy wash coming down out of them, two ranches, a substation, and a small town on the fan. Arrays sit in eight places, each outlined in the color of its farming-axis position. S0: a reclaimed gravel pit, grazed under the panels. S1: a vineyard under a canopy of panels, and rangeland on the foothills grazed as it was. S2: an alfalfa field turned to grazing under an array. S3: a whole field taken beside the substation. S4: arrays in the two dry corners of a working center pivot. S5: a retired irrigated field, its old pivot tracks still faintly visible, under a large array.
